blocks.label: Overview
bullets: Supports The Structural Integrity of Bones
1000 IU (25 mcg) D3 | 45 mcg K2 as MK-7 Per 1 Gummy
paragraphs: The combination of vitamin D3 and vitamin K2 provides enhanced support for the health and maintenance of normal bones. Vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol) is the most easily absorbed and utilized form of vitamin D. Vitamin K2 as menaquinone-7 is the most bioactive and bioavailable form of vitamin K.

Together, these vitamins work in tandem to support osteoblasts (bone-forming cells), facilitate calcium and phosphorus balance in the blood, and promote healthy muscle function. Each great-tasting, chewable gummy provides 1000 IU (25 mcg) of vitamin D3 plus 45 mcg of vitamin K2.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Adults take one gummy daily, with food, or as directed by your health care professional.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Organic cane sugar, organic tapioca syrup, purified water, pectin, natural flavor, citric acid, fumaric acid, sodium citrate dihydrate, fruit and vegetable juice (color).
No gluten, milk derivatives, or artificially derived colors or flavors.
This product and its ingredients do not contain common GE genes or proteins.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Store in a cool, dry place, away from sunlight. Do not take if tamper-evident seal is broken or missing. Keep out of the reach of children.

Consult with your physician before taking this product if have a known medical condition (including bleeding disorders, kidney disorders or hypercalcemia), or are taking medications (including blood thinners).
